property_summary: In the reference C, approveTransfer can only be called successfully by the lender of the given loan (here, since no loan is created, by address(0) never by a fuzzed caller), so approvals[loanID] stays address(0) after any attempted call by a non-lender; the mutant lets any caller write approvals, so some caller/id/to input leaves approvals non-zero.
change_summary: Delete the access-control revert so any caller can set approvals for any loanID.
